result.title: GenRF: Generative Registration-free Image Fusion
result.summary: Multi-modal image fusion combines complementary observations to improve scene visibility and perception. However, in real-world acquisition, differences in sensing principles and configurations introduce geometric discrepancies, while degradations further compromise source quality. Existing methods typically rely on explicit registration, yet large parallax complicates correspondence estimation, while mismatched fields of view leave some regions without cross-modal counterparts. Meanwhile, independent restoration underuses cross-modal information, whereas restoration-fusion methods assuming alignment remain vulnerable to misregistration. This study revisits misaligned and degraded image fusion in the era of generative foundation models, in which cross-attention enables position-agnostic complementary information aggregation, while generative priors support degradation recovery and inference in missing regions. Building on this perspective, we propose GenRF, which adapts pretrained FLUX through LoRA to jointly enhance degraded observations, infer missing cross-modal context, and fuse complementary information without explicitly estimating deformation fields. Extensive experiments on real-world infrared and visible captures show that GenRF delivers high-quality fusion directly from unregistered, degraded images without preprocessing, while improving downstream task performance under misalignment. Additional experiments demonstrate that GenRF can generalize to misaligned multi-exposure and multi-focus image fusion without task-specific fine-tuning. Project: https://linfeng-tang.github.io/GenRF.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 GenRF，用 LoRA 适配预训练 FLUX 生成模型，在无需显式配准和预处理的情况下，对存在几何错位、退化及跨模态视野缺失的红外-可见图像联合完成退化恢复、缺失区域推断与信息融合。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「不估计形变场、依赖 cross-attention 做位置无关的跨模态互补信息聚合」可作为方法线索，供核查 LVR 中跨视图、错位视觉证据的对齐与筛选；但任务本身是图像融合生成，与推理期 latent 状态生成无直接关系。
